# beachcomber

> One daemon. One cache. Every consumer reads from it.

beachcomber is a Rust daemon that computes shell-environment facts once — git
status, Kubernetes context, battery, and more — and caches them. Prompts,
status bars, and editors read the cache instead of forking a process per
keystroke. It replaces the per-shell daemon model, where 30 open terminals mean
30 gitstatusd instances all computing the same answer.

MIT licensed. Source: https://github.com/NavistAu/beachcomber
